name: Linux Server Diagnostics
description: Inspect CPU, memory, disk, processes, ports, services, and logs, then name a cause only when the output supports it.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run a read-only check on a configured server alias.
Run the same read-only check when the machine is local.
Read a local unit or config the check names.
Read logs from a local process ORVYN started.

validation.rule: The cause cites command output for CPU, memory, disk, processes, ports, services, or logs, and no mutating command ran unless that output required a repair.
